context.problem_statement: Analyze a 5-stage e-commerce conversion funnel: Home -> Product Page -> Add to Cart -> Checkout -> Purchase. For the provided user session data, compute: (1) unique users at each funnel stage, (2) stage-to-stage conversion rates (e.g., Home to Product Page), (3) cumulative conversion rate from Home to each stage, (4) drop-off rate at each stage (1 - conversion rate), (5) identify the biggest drop-off stage. Also compute conversion rates broken down by device type (mobile vs desktop).
context.expert_knowledge: Funnel analysis is key for identifying UX bottlenecks. Stage conversion rate = users_at_stage_n / users_at_stage_(n-1). Overall conversion = users_at_purchase / users_at_home. Mobile typically shows lower conversion rates due to UX friction. Drop-off analysis guides CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) investments. Use pandas groupby for device-specific analysis.
